title: Tramwajarze
description: This project adds very cute bugs called "tramwajarz". The name comes from the Polish langugage.
body:
# Tramwajarze

A fun and casual custom mob addition created out of pure boredom, featuring unique models and a quirky reward system.

## Features

### 🐛 The Tramwajarz
Look how beautiful these creatures are! 
*   **Behavior:** Completely passive towards players. However, they are easily scared and will quickly run away if they take any damage!
*   **Spawn Rate:** They have a spawn weight set to **70**, making them quite common encounters in your Minecraft world.
*   **Drops:** Defeating a Tramwajarz will reward you with a **Shell** and **String**.

### 🏆 The Challenge Items
This mod adds a unique challenge aspect to your survival world with very hard-to-get items.
*   **The Catch:** These items are incredibly difficult to obtain—even harder than Netherite! 
*   **The Twist:** Despite their extreme rarity, they are literally worse than standard Iron tools and armor. It is the ultimate flex for bored survival players!

---

## Technical Details

*   **Platform:** Minecraft 1.21.8
*   **Mod Loader:** NeoForge
*   **Dependencies:** Standalone mod. No external dependencies or other mods required! Just drag, drop, and play. :D
*   **Creation Tools:** Made using MCreator. The Tramwajarz model and title image were created with Blockbench.
*   **Visuals:** Shaders used in the project screenshots are [Complementary Reimagined](https://modrinth.com).
